_comment: Registry of custom vLLM parser plugins. Single source of truth for both
the probe driver (scripts/_probe_hf_common.py) and the router
(gpu-arbiter/main.go). Adding a new plugin = drop the .py file in
scripts/vllm_plugins/ and add one entry below — no code changes.
plugins.<name>.kind  one of {tool, reasoning} (which vLLM flag the
plugins.<name>.file  basename of the plugin .py inside scripts/vllm_plugins/
Both Python and Go look up parser names against this map: when the
name is present, the launch gets `--tool-parser-plugin <abs>` (or
flag, and the plugin directory is bind-mounted into the backend
container at /etc/devai/vllm-plugins:ro. Names absent from this map
are treated as built-in vLLM parsers and pass through unchanged.
